serviceDescription: The Delaware General Assembly consists of 62 legislators in Delaware. The General Assembly is comprised of 21 Senators and 41 Representatives. Senators are elected to 4 years terms and Representatives are elected to 2 years terms. The dataset reflects the current General Assembly.The districts were created after the 2010 decennial census and will be updated again after the 2020 decennial census if necessary. Districts are created based on information from the decennial census.Election district boundaries (RD-ED) updated in November 2023.
